info.name: Hot Metal — Agents API v1
info.description:
# Hot Metal Agents API v1

The public REST API for agents, scripts, and integrations: manage publications and topics, have the writer agent draft a post, publish it, or store a post you wrote yourself.

## Auth

Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer hm_...`. Create a key in the Hot Metal dashboard and set the `apiKey` collection variable.

## Envelopes

Success is `{ "data": ... }`; failure is `{ "error": "...", "code": "..." }`.

## Two ways to create a post

`POST /publications/{id}/drafts/generate` asks the writer agent to research and write something new (metered by the weekly post quota). `POST /publications/{id}/posts` stores a post you already wrote, exactly as given, and accepts `publishedAt` so existing content keeps its original date (not metered).

Generated from `apps/web/src/agents-api/v1/openapi-spec.ts`; see `docs/API_GUIDE.md`.

request.description: Returns a single publication with its topics array.

Updates publication settings. All fields are optional.

**`templateId`** selects the public blog design. Allowed values:

- `starter` — Clean, minimal, content-focused design.
- `editorial` — Magazine-style with serif typography and drop caps.
- `bold` — Tech-forward with geometric layout and thick borders.
- `press-machine` — A newspaper front page: ruled columns, a commanding lead headline, and a typographic date plate where a post has no image.
- `one-signal` — A dark dispatch log: a numbered index instead of cards, with a long-form reading column.
- `cover-stock` — Every post gets a typographic cover: a face-out bookshelf home page, and an article that opens on its own cover.
- `horizon` — Time is the spine: a large date axis across the top, posts hung from their real dates, and only "now" in colour.
- `poster` — The headline is the argument: the lead title fills the first screen, the archive is a wall of type, images appear only on hover.

An unknown value is rejected with 400. Every template renders on both the EmDash fleet and the legacy frontend.

request.description: Stores a post from content you already have, exactly as given — the counterpart to `generateDraft`, which asks the writer agent to research and write something new. Markdown is rendered to HTML on write, so the two never drift. Set `publishedAt` to backdate a post, which is how existing content is imported without the whole archive landing on today's date. Does not count against the weekly post quota, which meters writer-agent sessions.

item.name: Topics

request.description:
Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}` (an `hm_` API key), inherited from collection auth. Response Content-Type: application/json. No query parameters.

`GET {{baseUrl}}/publications/{{publicationId}}/topics`

Path parameter: `publicationId` is the owned publication UUID.

No request body. Returns all active and inactive topics ordered by priority descending, then creation ascending. Response: `{ "data": [...] }`, including `{ "data": [] }` for an empty publication.

Missing/invalid credentials return 401. Missing or inaccessible resources return 404, not 403. POST creation quota failures return 403 with `error`, `code`, `limit`, `current`, and `upgradeEmail`. Other validation failures return 400 with `error` and `code` (`VALIDATION_ERROR` or `INVALID_JSON`).

response.name: 200 — Topics listed
401 — Missing API key

request.description:
Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}` (an `hm_` API key), inherited from collection auth. Response Content-Type: application/json. No query parameters.

`POST {{baseUrl}}/publications/{{publicationId}}/topics`

Path parameter: `publicationId` is the owned publication UUID.

| Body field | Type | Required / default |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Required; trimmed and must remain nonblank. |
| `description` | string or null | Optional; strings trimmed; null/omitted is stored as null. |
| `priority` | integer 1/2/3 | Optional; defaults to 1. Strings and null are invalid. |

New topics have `isActive: true`. Creation checks the current user's active-topic count: Creator limit 3; Growth/Enterprise unlimited.

Response: `{ "data": topic }`.

Missing/invalid credentials return 401. Missing or inaccessible resources return 404, not 403. POST creation quota failures return 403 with `error`, `code`, `limit`, `current`, and `upgradeEmail`. Other validation failures return 400 with `error` and `code` (`VALIDATION_ERROR` or `INVALID_JSON`).

request.description:
Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}` (an `hm_` API key), inherited from collection auth. Response Content-Type: application/json. No query parameters.

`PATCH {{baseUrl}}/topics/{{topicId}}`

Path parameter: `topicId` is the topic UUID; ownership is resolved through its actual parent publication.

| Body field | Type | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string or null | Optional; strings trimmed (including empty string); null/omitted is a no-op. |
| `description` | string or null | Optional; strings preserved as supplied; null clears it; omitted is a no-op. |
| `priority` | integer 1/2/3 | Optional; null and numeric strings are invalid. |
| `isActive` | boolean | Optional; strings, numbers and null are invalid. |

All fields are optional. Send `{}` for a no-op; do not omit the JSON body.

Response: `{ "data": topic }`.

Missing/invalid credentials return 401. Missing or inaccessible resources return 404, not 403. POST creation quota failures return 403 with `error`, `code`, `limit`, `current`, and `upgradeEmail`. Other validation failures return 400 with `error` and `code` (`VALIDATION_ERROR` or `INVALID_JSON`).

response.name: 404 — Parent publication missing or not owned
401 — Missing API key

item.description:
Topic CRUD uses the shared business layer for ownership, current-tier quota checks, defaults and field validation. This refactor does not add MCP/OAuth support.

Authentication is inherited from the collection: `Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}` (an `hm_` API key). Every request requires it. Send `Accept: application/json`; POST/PATCH also send `Content-Type: application/json`. No topic endpoint accepts query parameters.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string UUID | Topic ID, not the publication ID. |
| `publicationId` | string UUID | Actual parent publication. |
| `name` | string | Topic name. |
| `description` | string or null | Description; null means unset. |
| `priority` | integer 1/2/3 | 1 = Normal, 2 = High, 3 = Urgent. |
| `isActive` | boolean | Whether scouting uses the topic. |
| `createdAt`, `updatedAt` | integer | Unix seconds. |

POST/PATCH require a JSON object. Malformed/missing JSON is 400; arrays, null and primitives are 400 before resource lookup. Incorrectly typed fields are validation failures with 400 (instead of TypeError500 or silently accepted values). Unknown fields are ignored.
